newsitem.title: USA: New Holland names Lloyd Bentsen chairman.
newsitem.headline: New Holland names Lloyd Bentsen chairman.

text.p: Agricultural equipment maker New Holland NV said Tuesday that former Treasury Secretary Lloyd Bentsen had been appointed chairman of its board of directors.
The Dutch company said that Bentsen's experience in finance, international trade and public policy would prove to be a valuable asset for the company.
It did not say who Bentsen would replace in the post.
Bentsen, formerly a senator from Texas, was named to the Treasury post by President Clinton in January 1993 and served in the administration until December, 1994.
New Holland was formed in May 1991 through the merger of the business of Fiat Geotech SpA and Ford New Holland companies.
